verdict.rationale: The Agent Skills spec requires each SKILL.md to open with YAML frontmatter, and agents load each skill's name and description at startup to decide when it is relevant. That description doubles as the 'what it does / when it activates' documentation, and developers can inspect it with `--list` before installing or check structure with `skills-ref validate`. However, activation is inferred by the agent from free-text descriptions rather than declared triggers. Description quality is left to authors, and community feedback notes that descriptions aren't surfaced in the skills.sh listing. Missing for 10: evidence that a meaningful description is enforced on every skill, explicit documented activation conditions or triggers, descriptions shown in the skills.sh directory, and hands-on corroboration that activation is predictable.
